Q: Properly using Yocto multiconf with shared information A:

The code behind multiconfig knows about sstate, so if the two build directories have overlap in sstate, one will generate it and then the other TMPDIR will wait and use it. That way you can run the two bitbake commands in parallel as much as is practical.
